connector.name: Anthropic Admin MCP
connector.registryDescription: Native MCP server for the Anthropic Admin API: org, workspaces, members, API keys, usage, costs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package anthropic-admin-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the trushtonfactory account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_ADMIN_KEY
env.description: Your Anthropic Admin API key (Console -> Settings -> Admin Keys). Required.

env.name: ALLOWED_WORKSPACES
env.description: Optional comma-separated workspace IDs to scope write tools to. Recommended for least-privilege setups.

env.name: AUDIT_LOG_PATH
env.description: Path for JSONL audit log of mutating operations. Defaults to ./audit.jsonl.
